title: Quantity per Rolling 30 Days on a Member-Filed First-Time Quantity Limit Exception — Utilization Management Program
content:
**Determination.** The quantity per rolling 30 days that a member-filed first-time quantity limit exception request asks for under the Utilization Management Program, on the acute migraine drugs that carry a quantity limit — sumatriptan, whose limit is 9 units, Nurtec ODT, whose limit is 8 units, and Ubrelvy, whose limit is 16 units per rolling 30 days — is fixed as follows.

1. **The drug.** The drug is the drug of the member's most recent quantity limit exception case event.
2. **The basis.** The request asks for the quantity per rolling 30 days that the member's newest prescription for the drug on file at Northbridge Rx Home Delivery (the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy) directs: its quantity per fill multiplied by 30 and divided by its days supply per fill, rounded to three decimal places only at the end. The newest prescription is the one with the latest written date.
3. **No prescription at home delivery.** When the member holds no prescription for the drug at home delivery, the quantity and days supply of the member's most recent paid retail fill of the drug stand in for the prescription's.
4. **The member-request ceiling.** The request never asks for more than the member-request ceiling, which is the drug's limit times three quarters (0.75) of the package's maximum exception multiple, taken to three decimal places. The quantity recorded on the request is the smaller of the quantity asked for and that ceiling.

The package's maximum exception multiple is the figure the member's review package states for quantity limit exceptions.

## Worked determinations (hypothetical inputs)

| | Ubrelvy | sumatriptan | Nurtec ODT |
|---|---|---|---|
| Package's maximum exception multiple | 2.0 | 1.5 | 2.0 |
| Member-request ceiling | 16 times three quarters of 2.0: 24.000 | 9 times three quarters of 1.5: 10.125 | 8 times three quarters of 2.0: 12.000 |
| Basis on file | home delivery prescription, 30 tablets per 90-day fill | no home delivery prescription; latest paid retail fill 18 tablets for 30 days | home delivery prescription, 16 tablets per 45-day fill |
| Quantity per 30 days | 30 multiplied by 30, divided by 90: 10.000 | 18 multiplied by 30, divided by 30: 18.000 | 16 multiplied by 30, divided by 45: 10.667 |
| Recorded (the smaller) | 10.000 | 10.125 | 10.667 |

In the sumatriptan column the quantity per 30 days exceeds the ceiling, so the ceiling of 10.125 is what the request asks for. In the Nurtec ODT column the division gives 10.6666…, and the rounding to three decimal places is applied once, at the end, giving 10.667.

### Points of judgement

- **Which prescription?** The newest one on file at home delivery for the drug, by written date; an older home delivery prescription for the same drug does not count.
- **When does a retail fill count?** Only when the member holds no home delivery prescription for the drug; then the most recent paid retail fill's quantity and days supply are used.
